text: 【个人住房贷款政策有大变化：个人住房贷款最长期限延长至40年 还款困难可协商调整还款计划】中国人民银行、金融监管总局联合印发《关于改革完善房地产信贷管理推动加快构建房地产发展新模式的意见》。关于个人住房贷款政策，有这些变化。
text_en: Major changes to individual housing loan policy: maximum term extended to 40 years, repayment plans adjustable through negotiation in case of difficulty. The People's Bank of China and the National Financial Regulatory Administration jointly issued the "Opinions on Reforming and Improving Real Estate Credit Management to Accelerate the Building of a New Real Estate Development Model." These are the changes regarding individual housing loan policy.
